marc:datafield.marc:subfield: எனை நனைத்த தேன் மழையே! | Enai Nanaitta Ten Malaiye!

In "Eṉai Naṉaitta Tēṉ Maḻaiyē!" by Nityashree Shekhar, Mugilan, a village youth, treasures his mother and two sisters as his entire world. During a visit to Coimbatore, he encounters Varsha, whose childlike innocence and spirited nature captivate him. Their paths cross again when she stays at his home as his sisters' friend, and they begin to fall in love. However, circumstances prevent them from expressing their feelings, leaving Varsha torn between being with Mugilan and moving on. The story unfolds as Mugilan and Varsha navigate these challenges to find their way to each other.
